creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Reported by the owner, 2026-11-09: after he answers an agent's message from Muster's banner, that agent's card stays in the Needs you strip. Answering should take it out, as reading the message would.

Not yet checked: whether a reply sent from the banner marks the message read in the core. The strip is `Attention::asking()` (a_2wKWA2xiE), which counts messages held for the person, so a reply that leaves the message unread would keep the card there. The banner staying up after a reply may share the cause.
title: Replying to a message from its banner leaves the agent in the Needs you strip
